name: Pie for Billy
summary: In Elwynn, you gather meat for Bernice's pie while Billy holds back what he knows about her necklace. Bernice agrees to bake, though she believes Billy stole her family's jewelry.

sections.title: A Boy's Bribe
sections.body: Billy Maclure gives no apology when you ask about the necklace. He will neither return it nor name who has it until he gets a freshly baked pork belly pie. He knows Bernice is the finest cook in the valley, and means to enjoy the bargain.

sections.title: Baking Through Bad Blood
sections.body: Bernice is furious at the thought of feeding the boy she believes stole her family's jewelry. Still, she agrees to bake before you gather the meat. You bring her meat from wild boars roaming nearby pastures. She sets aside her pride, hoping to get her prized necklace back.

faq.q: Why does Billy want a pie before talking?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure knows where Auntie Bernice's necklace is, and uses that knowledge to bargain for food. He will not say who has it until he gets one of Bernice's pork belly pies.

faq.q: Why does Auntie Bernice agree to bake for a thief?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice is furious at the boy she believes stole her necklace, but sees no other way to recover it. She agrees to bake when you bring her boar meat, putting the return of her property before her pride.

faq.q: Where does the meat for the pie come from?
faq.answer: The meat comes from wild boars foraging in Elwynn Forest, in the meadows and along the edges of the Stonefield and Maclure farms.

faq.q: What is the history between the Stonefields and Maclures?
faq.answer: The Stonefield and Maclure families are neighboring farmers with a bitter rivalry that has lasted for years. They suspect each other of theft, vandalism, and bad-faith squabbling across their property lines.

faq.q: Did Billy actually steal the necklace?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice accuses Billy directly. He avoids a straight confession, but clearly knows where the necklace ended up and uses that knowledge to bargain for food.

faq.q: What happens after Bernice gets the meat?
faq.answer: When you bring her tender boar meat, Auntie Bernice bakes a pork belly pie for you to take to Billy. She hopes he will then reveal who has her necklace.

angles.text: Auntie Bernice says wild boar meat can be tough and bland. With proper spices and a slow simmer, it makes exceptional savory pie filling.
As a human, you see the stubborn, insular rivalries of Elwynn's rural homesteaders, just south of Stormwind's gates.
